title: Metabase Question Query Errors
dataSources: Superset logs (`superset:app`), Metabase logs (`metabase:app`), Redash logs (`redash:app`), and embed client events (`bi:embed:client`).
app: Superset/Metabase/Redash application and Celery worker logs via Universal Forwarder; application REST APIs and embed-SDK client telemetry via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=metabase:app ("query execution" AND ("failed" OR "error"))
| rex "card (?<card_id>\d+)"
| stats count as errors, values(error_type) as types by card_id, database_name
| where errors>0
| sort - errors
description: Surfaces Metabase saved-question (card) query execution errors grouped by database so broken questions from schema changes or permission issues are found quickly.
value: Broken Metabase questions erode self-service trust; grouping by database exposes systemic causes like a dropped column or a revoked grant.
implementation: Ingest Metabase application logs; schedule hourly and alert on error spikes per database, especially after warehouse migrations.
visualization: Table of card/database by errors with error types.
grandmaExplanation: We catch broken saved questions in Metabase so people are not stuck with reports that suddenly stop working.
